messages.author: 69012fad0e21379a
messages.subject: collapse() clade_name parameter in loop
parts:
I was testing the collapse() function in a loop and noticed that the clade_name parameter is not working under this scenario. I tested clade_label using just a single clade and it worked fine, so it seems the problem is trying to apply it in a loop.

tr <- read.tree(text = "((a,((b,c),(d,e))),f);")
p <- ggtree(tr) + geom_tiplab(size = 3)
nodes_to_collapse <- c(10, 11)
labels <- c("Clade 10", "Clade 11")

for(i in 1:length(nodes_to_collapse)){
  p <- collapse(p, node = nodes_to_collapse[i], clade_label = labels[i])
}

p + geom_nodelab(aes(subset = node == 10 | node == 11))
